prose: Fortune reports that Anthropic is setting up a presidential engagement program for the 2028 elections: an in-house team that will work with presidential candidates from both parties on AI policy, help leadership set political strategy and run the company's political funding program. It is hiring a Political Programs lead to build it.

The job posting says the person will map the fields in both parties, offer AI policy education to candidates and advisors on equal terms, and prepare executives for those talks. Fortune ties it to the November midterms and a possible IPO valuing Anthropic at up to $2 trillion, and says it shows how much AI firms now depend on government policy.
highlights: Anthropic building a presidential engagement program for 2028
Will educate candidates in both parties on AI policy
Team also runs political funding and advises leadership
Fortune links it to the IPO and midterms
